entries.title: WRATH: Aeon of Ruin
entries.definitive_edition: WRATH: Aeon of Ruin on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best flat-screen route because it is the native PC full-release path with PC settings/capture flexibility and no console-exclusive campaign content is documented; the VR Brutal Edition is a separate VR rebuild rather than a replacement for the flat-screen game.
primary.how_to_play: Buy WRATH: Aeon of Ruin on Steam for Windows PC and play the current native PC build.

entries.remaster_caveats: WRATH: Aeon of Ruin VR - Brutal Edition is a separate VR rebuild and is tracked as its own entry, not as a remaster replacing the flat-screen game.

entries.title: WRATH: Aeon of Ruin VR - Brutal Edition
entries.definitive_edition: WRATH: Aeon of Ruin VR - Brutal Edition on Windows PC VR

emulation.notes: Use the native SteamVR/OpenXR release with a supported VR headset; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC VR headset and GPU dependent.

primary.why: The Windows PC VR version is the best route for the VR rebuild because it has OpenXR PC VR support with PC GPU requirements, giving it the highest fidelity ceiling, while Quest and PS VR2 do not have exclusive campaign content over PC VR.
primary.how_to_play: Buy WRATH: Aeon of Ruin VR - Brutal Edition on Steam for Windows PC and play through a supported OpenXR/SteamVR headset.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a VR rebuild/enhancement of WRATH, not the flat-screen game; keep it separate from the original PC/console route.
